Exercise: Push-Ups - Close Triceps Position

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- push

Primary Muscles:

- triceps

Secondary Muscles:

- chest
- shoulders

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- triceps_hypertrophy
- chest_and_shoulder_strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder injuries
- Recent elbow surgery

Exercise Variations:

- name: Wide-Grip Push-Ups, force: push, level: intermediate
- name: Diamond Push-Ups, force: push, level: intermediate

Substitution Options:

- name: Incline Push-Ups, force: push, level: intermediate
- name: Tricep Dips, force: push, level: intermediate

Instructions:

- Lie on the floor face down and place your hands closer than shoulder width for a close hand position. Make sure that you are holding your torso up at arms' length.
- Lower yourself until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.
- Using your triceps and some of your pectoral muscles, press your upper body back up to the starting position and squeeze your chest. Breathe out as you perform this step.
- After a second pause at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
